title: Unit Event — THE POWER OF UNITY

meta.Outline: As Akito repeatedly watches the video of RAD WEEKEND, he realizes that creating a certain "atmosphere" may be the key to surpassing the legend. Then, he hears that Len and the others are going to put on an event in SEKAI.

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We're practicing this early in the morning, but they all sound amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess what we saw made a pretty big impact...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Even as a video, it was still that powerful...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (There are plenty of events where “a bunch of good teams gather to blow the roof off a place”...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But RAD WEEKEND was totally something else...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, I'm exhausted...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
We have been singing since this morning...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
We should all get in some rest after this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
But we'll need to catch our breath soon...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad and his team always seemed completely fine after singing for an entire day, so we've gotta keep building up our stamina.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right!
Let's just keep at it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (She's right about us needing to build our stamina. Plus, we've gotta keep polishing our rhythm and tone.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But is this the right way to go...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That place was full of musicians who became the best of the best by tirelessly honing their craft.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Unfortunately... We're gonna need more than just that to surpass RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Next, we have RUST!
They're all yours!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Next is... GLaP day!!
Are you guys ready?! Let's hear it!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And last but not least... Us!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: RADder!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If we're serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND, we're gonna have to find a way to create an even more insane atmosphere.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But that's way easier said than done...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've even seen some events put on by musicians who are supposedly on Ken and his team's level... But none of them have even come close.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That time, every team participating in RAD WEEKEND jockeyed to see who's the best... And joined together to go for the top.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They weren't just being driven by passion... All the teams battled to become the top dog, and it created an “atmosphere that pushed everyone forward”...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which means, if we actually want to surpass RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were just thinking about heading over to MEIKO's place for lunch.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, last time, Len said, “Stop by the next time you get a chance.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember that too.
Alright, let's head over to MEIKO's place.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you think Len was talking about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, I guess we'll find out when we get there! Let's take a break and hop on over...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're gonna put on our very own event...!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Let's do it!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “So”...? What led to this exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! I literally just went over that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were totally blown away by RAD WEEKEND, so we wanna try putting on our own event!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. It had a pretty big effect on you two, huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, I can see why too.
That video... It really was incredible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But this still feels very sudden.
I wasn't sure what to expect when you asked to see us...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I was surprised too...
But I'm for putting on an event since it sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Me too♪
It'll be nice to sing with everyone for a change...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
See?!
KAITO and Luka are in!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Miku, MEIKO, you both gotta be in it too!
It'll be such an amazing event if we have all of us in it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey.
We came to grab a bite.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hello.
Huh...? Everyone's here today.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, it's you guys!
Nice timing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Listen! Listen!
We were just talking about putting on our very own event!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: An event?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup! We decided to put one on ourselves after seeing that video of RAD WEEKEND with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That sounds nice.
Will you be doing it here?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! We're thinking about using the cafe's terrace! It's big, has all the equipment we need and plenty of seats!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, I didn't explicitly give you permission yet... But it looks like I don't have much of a choice now. Be sure to clean up after yourselves, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Woohoo!!
This is gonna be so great, you guys!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (An event, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Good for you, Len, Rin.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Putting on your own event, huh...?
That takes me back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It takes you back?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After I saw RAD WEEKEND, I was all like, “I wanna put on an event too!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I even gathered up all my friends and acquaintances to actually put one on!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you did...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
But to be fair, I didn't have the talent or experience to do much of anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wasn't all bad, but it ended up being nothing like what I had in mind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
After that, I gave it more thought and...
I decided that I'm gonna look for a partner that's just like my dad, practice a ton with and give it another go!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I never knew that...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't realize you already tried putting on your own event, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It honestly wasn't anything special.
All I really did was ask around, book a place, rehearse and take the stage.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I had no idea!
That sounds very fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since we're going to be putting on an event, why don't all of you also try putting one together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I bet it'll turn out great since you have Kohane and the guys now. Plus, you've all been practicing a ton together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Good point...
I was waiting until we'd gotten better as a team, but it might actually be a good opportunity for us to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I like it...
Let's try putting on our own event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It could even give us a “hint” in terms of what to do moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A hint...?
Care to elaborate, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This thought popped into my head when I was thinking about RAD WEEKEND just now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It wasn't just any old event where “a bunch of good teams gather to blow the roof off a place”...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, it wasn't?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought it was a really amazing event because all these really amazing people were there to sing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're not wrong about needing amazing skills, but that alone won't make an event great...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The reason RAD WEEKEND became so legendary was because of that “atmosphere”.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The atmosphere?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally get what you mean!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It was just, well... Awesome!
Everybody there was singing with everything they had like their lives depended on it, you know...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'd been to a few events with people as good as my dad and his team before, but that night was different... Nothing else has ever come close to that atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Which is why it felt so heated.
Those teams were ready to put everything on the line, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but they also sort of became a single unit that focused on achieving one goal...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I felt that too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was like every team participating RAD WEEKEND came together to produce that unbelievable atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I have no idea how we're going to achieve what they did... Which is why putting on an event ourselves might give us a clue.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
In that case, I'm in!
I mean, a lot of stuff in life involves just trying it out and seeing what happens, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree...!
That feeling of excitement coursing through your entire body... I wanna make others feel that way!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, I believe we're in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I guess it's time for us to get moving.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool! Between this SEKAI and you guys' world, we get to have a double event!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds lovely!
I'm getting excited just thinking about it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, you guys, let's all settle down a bit...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, nothing's actually been decided yet...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did someone's stomach grumble just now...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not mine...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me neither.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
My apologies...
I didn't realize how hungry I was...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, it was you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're all still growing, so why don't we take this opportunity to have lunch?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And we can talk more about our event afterwards!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Oh, wait... I'm supposed to practice with Taiga this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, we can discuss this again at another time. How does that sound, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If we're really going through with this, we're coming out of this with the result we want...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We've gotta figure out the secret behind that atmosphere...)
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice work today!
See you two later!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, time for us to head to the station and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What up, Toya? You seem anxious.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, it's just...
I think I'm excited about us putting on an actual event. It'll probably be on my mind for a while after I get home too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but you gotta relax for now. We're gonna talk more about what to do for it tomorrow anyway.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: From picking a venue to putting a set list together... And most importantly, figuring out who's gonna be performing with us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That voice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's him...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I still can't hit that high note... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito, Toya.
You guys heading home?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah. You still practicing?
We never see you out here this late.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
That's right!
I've been super stoked lately!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You have? Are you gonna be in a big event or something?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I mean, it's just...
You guys have been on fire...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I mean... So...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Seeing you guys and Tono doing so well made me realize that I should probably try a little harder.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Surpassing RAD WEEKEND sounded totally impossible at first, but I'm starting to think that you guys might actually pull it off...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm not exactly the greatest musician out there, but everyone wants to do a huge event at least once in their lives, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I get I'm not as good as you guys, but that's sort of been on my mind lately...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? You, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: S-So what?! Is it weird for me to think that?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, not at all...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, that makes you our rival, so you better be ready if we meet during a battle.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be giving it everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: O-Okay...!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, I think we've kept you long enough. Good luck with practice.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Thanks!
You guys get home safe!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I never thought he'd become this motivated...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seem happy, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? I do?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess it's because I'm seeing more and more people make surpassing RAD WEEKEND their goal...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Outside of us, Tono was about the only one who had made it their goal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Tono, huh...?
Rumor has it that he's been singing everywhere around here since losing to Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wonder what he's up to now...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (How long has it been since then...?)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Since I lost to Taiga...)

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
Arata...
If you're serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND, keep this one thing in mind.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: “Take a look at this city”...huh?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (I've been entering into as many Vivid Street events as I can and talked to almost every musician that I've seen. I've even all but memorized all the back alleys around here.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (But I still don't understand what Taiga meant...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
A message...?
Who'd be contacting me at this hour...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
He's here...
Again...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Then, I have even less time to think...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Especially since I still need to...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: And I heard over at An's place that Vivid BAD SQUAD's gonna be putting on their own event!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Whoa! I can't wait to see what that's like!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: They've been getting better with each performance, so it's gonna be totally outta this world, right?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Who else do you think's gonna be there?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Hmm... It might be a short list since there aren't many teams around here that can sing like them...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD's putting on an event...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Of course they are. They have to if they wish to get closer to surpassing RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (And someday, I'll...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I've been participating in all these events up until now...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (But I've never tried to put an event together with someone else who also wants to surpass RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: This could be my chance to discover something new...
The next day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's start talking about our event!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
C'mon, Kohane, you too...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we have a lot of decisions to make. First...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, me first! Let's pick a venue! We can't really get the ball rolling without knowing where you're gonna be playing, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
True.
What else is there? A date and time, I suppose?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even though you usually run late, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha! I can't help but take my time, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mind being quiet for a minute, you guys? This isn't getting us anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree. This is their event.
We have our own event to think about.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't you start by writing a list of what you need to do? As for Len and the others, I'll jot everything down.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
Yes, let's put some notes together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A venue. A date and time. What else...? Other participants...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We should be set in terms of a venue...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So let's think about who else is gonna be there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's no way we'll produce that atmosphere if we don't choose the right people.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
True...
I agree that this is a good place to start.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But who else should be there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, anyone who wants to surpass RAD WEEKEND, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, people who can sing with literally everything they have! That's an absolute must!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's very general...
But the one person who fits that bill is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Surely, none other than Tono.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. And he's an amazing singer...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only that, but he also wants to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you think, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't worry, I'm with you guys there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No one else out there has his kind of resolve or singing ability, so he'll be perfect for our event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But the question is whether or not he'll agree to this...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm talking about if he'll see any merit in participating in our event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There are rumors going around that he's been invited to participate in some fairly high-level events... He probably doesn't see any reason to go out of his way to join ours, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see...
In that case, you might be right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we won't really know until we ask, right? He might just accept our offer without a second thought!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's true too...
There's no use in dwelling on this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's try talking to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. Is there anyone else you'd like to ask?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If we hope to learn more about RAD WEEKEND's atmosphere, we'll likely want to have a similar number of performers participating. I'd say at least two more teams...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... But I feel like there just aren't many people besides us or Arata who're actually serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's do what we can for now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which means...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna go talk to Tono.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, let's start searching...
He usually sings at one of the bigger places around here, so we should be able to find him pretty quick.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right.
Oh, what if we looked up where he's supposed to be performing...? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I tried searching for event participants, but I'm not seeing anything recent regarding Tono.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You think something's up?
I guess it could just be that there isn't any info out there. Oh, what if he's training because he lost to Uncle Taiga?!
Haha. Training? No.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Hello, Vivid BAD SQUAD.
How's it going?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tono?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(We're here to invite him...
I wasn't expecting him to find us first.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What brings you here, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, I came here to look for all of you in the hopes that I could ask you something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ask us...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. I heard from some people who looked like they were Weekend Garage customers that you guys are thinking about putting on your own event.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I participated in that event...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you wanna be in it?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. That is if you're all okay with it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Again, we came here to invite him...
Talk about an offer you can't refuse...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What made you want to be in our event...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're being invited to join all these other big events left and right, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, but something's telling me that I have a lot to gain by joining up with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something's telling you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, we originally came here to invite him. There's no reason to refuse his offer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
In that case, we'll be looking forward to working with you...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, I will as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Let's make this event a good one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... We're looking forward to working with you!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Likewise. By the way... Have you spoken to anybody else about this? I'd prefer to know who if you already have.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, not yet...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We want to find people who also want to surpass RAD WEEKEND, but there just aren't many out there, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: If that's the case, how about “EVER”?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
EVER?
As in the guys we battled during STAY GOLDEN...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. I spoke with them just the other day and they seem to be working towards surpassing RAD WEEKEND as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, why...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Why don't you ask them yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If that possibility exists, I say we take a chance and go talk to them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Some customers at my place are all tight with EVER, so they might know how to contact them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Alright, let's try setting up a meeting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Something feels off...)

rows.Speaker: Akito

This situation could also apply to that Tono person you were talking about earlier.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How you may be getting the wrong idea. Based on what I heard just now, their resolve seems fairly strong on top of being very talented...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All the while they may have a lot on their mind, like you guys. What if something's really bothering them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something bothering him...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that could be the case.
As talented as Tono is, he's not exactly a perfect human being.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you think this has anything to do with why he hasn't been in many events lately?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Or is losing to Uncle Taiga still eating away at him?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he doesn't seem like that soft a person...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You may want to sit down and discuss that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once you reach an understanding... Yes, you'll all surely become a delicious batch of pancakes!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: P-Pancakes...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's right!
You aren't guaranteed to end up with delicious pancakes just because you gathered up some good ingredients!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You have to mix the batter well and cook them right to get them to be nice and fluffy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe events are no different. It can only become good after you've all mixed together and reach an understanding with one another.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An understanding with one another, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were convinced that we'd have to essentially compete against each other. It never crossed our minds to try and reach any sort of understanding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, understanding one another would make it easier for us to all work together. That's the same for basketball or any other team sport!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. Getting to understand each other is bound to make our event even better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Exactly!
That's why I think it'd be good for all of you to get to know this Tono person and the other performers better.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that's definitely worth giving a shot...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thanks, KAITO.
We'll try everything that we can.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful! I wish you the best of luck!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, how do some freshly made pancakes sound?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! They look so yummy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They were actually supposed to look much fluffier, but I just couldn't get them to rise more...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. MEIKO said how mixing the batter overzealously will prevent them from becoming nice and fluffy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luckily, these turned out beautifully! Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why do I not feel reassured by that...?
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, I'm so glad we did this today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The pancakes KAITO made were so good too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah... Anyway, we really gotta get moving starting tomorrow. We need to find a way to get on the same page as Tono, as well as Mita, Okazaki and the others.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
L-Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For now, let's call it a day and get some rest.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, nice work today!
See you guys tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
Let's start heading home too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Over there. Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tono...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay. I'll head over now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's on his phone again...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But with who...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe events are no different. It can only become good after you've all mixed together and reach an understanding with one another.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, mind if I go over to talk to him...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
After all, I'd like to make some delicious pancakes too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Says the guy who doesn't like sweets...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tono...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, Shinonome, Aoyagi.
Were you both about to head home?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We were doing some planning together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tono, what were you doing here just now?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh...
Just dealing with some things.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do any of the calls you got the other day have anything to do with this...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've been giving us good performances on stage and helpful advice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we can all tell that something's been on your mind lately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As fellow performers participating in the same event, we thought we should ask.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Was it that obvious?
I guess I still have a long way to go.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: The truth is, I was about to go visit my partner at the hospital just over that way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your partner? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What happened to this “partner” of yours?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: They're far away in a different city now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In a different city? So you're not performing together? Don't they want to surpass RAD WEEKEND too?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: They can't sing anymore. Not after the accident...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Accident...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: A traffic accident. This car ran through an intersection and...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Well, they lived, but some parts of their body became paralyzed. Singing was no longer really possible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, the hospital just over there...?
What happened to them being somewhere far away?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Originally, he was.
But he was desperate to come back and started feeling a little better recently, so he got permission to transfer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Transfer?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. After discussing the matter at length and realizing that his parents would be too busy with work, I decided to help him with the transfer process.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He wants to be as close as he can to this city it seems...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh...
Why don't you join me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He loves listening to music by everyone from Vivid Street. He's starting to get bored of me going on about myself, so I'd like it if you could tell him some fun stories.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Would you mind...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll go...
How about you, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Alright, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Tono's partner...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What's he gonna be like...?)
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Soma, I'm here...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Hey, Arata!
Thanks for making the trip!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: So, how's practice for that event going? Good?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hm? Those guys behind you...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hehe. Can you guess who they are?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh... Hey...
Sorry for the sudden intrusion. I'm...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Whoa!!
Aren't you guys in Vivid BAD SQUAD?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, that was quick. You could've made it a little more interesting.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Are you kidding me?!
Haven't you realized just how much you've been talking about Vivid BAD SQUAD lately?!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You're Shinonome and Aoyagi, right?
He's told me all about you guys!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
I'm Soma Miyata.
This dude's best friend!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I bumped into them just outside the hospital and asked them to join me since it seemed like a nice opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: They're very well acquainted with Ken, so I'm sure you know there's plenty you'll want to ask them.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Really?
But you guys are probably really busy right now since your event's just around your corner... Oops.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yeah, sorry about that...!
My body isn't all that mobile because of the accident, and I get woozy just sitting up in bed sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Oh, right...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I totally forgot since he seemed okay on the surface, but he's...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please let us know if there's anything we can do for you.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Hey, Arata...
Is it just me or is Aoyagi really that nice?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, he's very kind and polite.
With none of the leers that Shinonome gives people sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm guessing he does that because you yank his chain sometimes, Arata. Sorry about that, Shinonome, but he's sort of always been this way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh... No...
You don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And you're right about Akito leering at people.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Arata was right. You guys are a riot!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, you guys are regulars at Ken's place, right? Mind if I ask how he's been lately?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Recently, Taiga's also been popping in and they usually end up talking for quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Cool. Ken and Taiga in the same place again...! Man, I'd do anything to be there!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Soma, have you ever been to Ken's place before?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: No, not yet... The accident happened before he opened up his shop.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I was able to transfer here, so I definitely wanna see them again! And ask them all about RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Even now, I still remember it...
Nagi began by singing and everyone started going nuts like the roof was on fire...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: It was such an amazing event...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Now I get it...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He was just as entranced by RAD WEEKEND and wants to find a way to surpass it...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Man, I had a blast!
Thanks for dropping by today, Shinonome, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you as well.
Please let us know if you ever want to chat again.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Awesome! Promise?
Come back soon, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Anyway, we should get going.
See you later, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Later!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Arata was right about them being nice guys...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Now...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I have my own stuff to take care of...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much.
Soma must've been a handful because of how excited he was.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not really. It was nice to hear about what Vivid Street used to be like back in the day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He seemed like a cheery guy...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, he's always been like that.
The accident was definitely tough for him, but he's pretty much back to being his old self now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Here we are!
Wait... Are we inside Akito's pocket?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh, this is fun!
It's like we're in a cave!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<You know we aren't here to play, right?
You were the one who said the event's getting close and want to give them your support... Hm?>

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But he seemed to have much more fun than usual thanks to you both. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Anyway... See you during our next practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey...
Isn't there something else you still need to say?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You seem dissatisfied.
If there's something you want to say, just say it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're fellow performers in the same event, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Alright, let me ask you this...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: What does it mean to “take a look at this city”?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That's what Taiga told me to do the other day.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: “If you're serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND...take a look at this city.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This city...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. Tricky one, right?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: After he said that, I went around everywhere looking for whatever it is that I was missing or needed to find...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I couldn't find the answer and became stuck.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
So stuck that...
Well, I got the idea that being at an event with all of you would lead me towards some sort of hint.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But seeing him makes me want to show him our dream... Of surpassing RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Which is why... I'd like you to tell me anything that comes to mind when you hear, “Take a look at this city.”

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Right now, that's what I need to know to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, I have no idea what it means to “take a look”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I promise to tell you if I do manage to figure out something since it seems like we also need to figure out the meaning behind those words...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'll think on it as well.
I'm also curious as to what it means.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Anyway, let's keep doing our best for the event. All to find a path towards producing that “atmosphere”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad we had a chance to discuss so much. I feel like we have a much better understanding of Tono now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, same...
His partner, his music... It was nice to hear about all of that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I agree! It was wonderful to hear their story!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I thought so too!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
How long have you two been there?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <When you started talking with that Tono person! We stayed in your pocket the whole time, so he probably didn't see us.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Just based on the bit we heard just now...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That Tono person seems very similar to you two.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, his personality may be very different.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But he cares about his partner very much and seems very serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND. I definitely see some similarities there.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<You even said so yourself, Akito.
You're all “fellow performers”, right?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! You guys all feel the same way, so I bet your event's gonna turn out great!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I was wrong about not knowing what he was thinking.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He feels the same way as us... Which means we're in this together.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, we're gonna need to move up the meeting time for tomorrow's practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have a feeling he'll agree to it, so mind letting An and Kohane know for me...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, I understand.
Let's keep doing our best to get even a whiff of that atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...!
A few days later
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Whoa! That was awesome...!
Way better than what you did during our other run...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You didn't seem to be running on all cylinders then. Did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, and I need to apologize to all of you.
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: My partner recently transferred to a hospital nearby and I've been helping him get settled...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I thought I'd found a way to separate my personal life from our practices, but I still wasn't able to focus. I'm sorry for causing you all so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Your partner...? You mean the one you're trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND with...?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You weren't always singing by yourself, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, we were chasing after the same dream... But he got into an accident and isn't able to perform on stage right now.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm not going to say that I'm going to grant his dream for him, but for his sake, I need to find a way to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So you're carrying his thoughts along with your own. That explains why you can sing with so much power, Tono...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's the reason you wanted to start singing, Okazaki?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Me...? Because this senior I looked up to liked to sing. The high school I used to go to was pretty rough...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: But they went after their dream of becoming a professional singer and didn't care if anyone laughed. I really admired that and decided to also start singing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A senior...? I see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What about you, Kotaro?
Was there a moment like that for you?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, when my little brother was born, I decided that I wanted to become a cool big brother. That happened to also be when I saw RAD WEEKEND, like Akito...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really...?! You have a little brother, Mita?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah!
He's still little, but really, really cute!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Aww, that's so adorable!
Oh, that means you gotta kick butt during our event to show him just how cool a big brother you are!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: R-Right...! He's still too little to come to our event, but I'll try to perform like he's actually there...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We still haven't gotten any closer to that atmosphere...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But the air between us is definitely starting to change bit by bit...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Or are we the ones that are changing...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like we all want to sing more and more good songs together now...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Alright, this place feels pretty good now...
Let's start from the top and give it our best today, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...!
The day of the event
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Everyone!
It's almost time for Akito and the others' event! Hurry!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We asked An to leave her phone in a place where no one else will find it, so we should be able to see everything!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, okay.
Alright, now that we all seem to be here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, let's go!
Live House
Backstage

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Wow! So many people!
Akito and the others must be really popular!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh...!
Everyone's gathering up over there!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What are they all doing?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Are they gathering to discuss something...?>
Live House
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Well...
The big day's already upon us.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Do you all feel ready?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
Right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
I'm ready to sing my heart out whenever!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same. Plus, we've put together a good crew. I'm sure things will turn out well for us.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
I agree.
However...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: No matter how much we practiced, it never felt like we ever came close to RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: The event itself is probably gonna be good, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't give up before it's even started...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I believe that all of us here are serious about what we're doing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No matter the cost, we all want to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Am I wrong in saying that we all feel that way?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If I'm right, we have to turn this event into a stepping stone towards achieving that goal.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: By struggling together, I'm sure we'll... No, I know we'll figure out something!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That atmosphere... The way it made everyone go totally nuts. We're gonna find a way to grab hold of it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Shinonome's right...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We don't have time to worry about what we can or can't do right now. For the sake of our dream, let's go out there and put on the best event possible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We're gonna surpass that night!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice speech, you guys!!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Griping won't get us anywhere...
So let's just go all out during the show.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah!!
And all the way until the end!!

rows.Speaker: Akito & Arata
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Our first event... “Break”.
Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(EVER's leading us off...!
We're gonna come out of the gates swinging...!)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Try to keep up, you guys...!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Whoa!
They're so cool!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They're supposed to be the team that won against Kohane and the others before... No wonder too... This event's just getting started, but they've already turned everything upside down.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, I like him!
He's got some force behind him♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's like he knows exactly what his best qualities are! I'm having fun just listening to him, and the audience seems to be enjoying his performance.>

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone!
But we're still just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Looks like we've gotten them good and excited. I'd say about as excited when the headliner for a normal event's about to take the stage...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But we're still nowhere near achieving “that atmosphere”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But I think we're getting closer... Well, that's just my feeling...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I think so too.
This audience looks beyond excited.

rows.Speaker: Arata
